name: Post-conversion action
description: Siren tells the app when a conversion is approved in a program that picks this action.

name: Post-allocation action
description: Siren tells the app when an allocation completes for a distributor that picks this action.

name: Payout method
description: Siren asks the app to pay a payout, in the currencies it names, when an autofulfiller picks this method.

name: Distribution resolver
description: Siren asks the app how to divide a distribution's pool when its distributor picks this resolver.

name: Custom event
description: The app sends Siren an event of its own at /event/{key}, with a short-lived token its key gets. Programs and distributors can credit it.

name: Metric calculation
description: Siren asks the app who scores, and how much, each time a metric triggers for a distributor whose metric type picks this calculation.

name: Customer filter for distributors
description: Siren asks the app whether a metric may score each time one triggers for a distributor that picks this filter.

name: Attribution model
description: Siren asks the app how to split a program's reward among the collaborators a sale or lead converted, when the program picks this resolver.

name: Transaction filter
description: Siren asks the app which of a sale's lines count, once per sale for each program or distributor that picks this filter.

name: Incentive structure
description: Siren asks the app which engagements a sale, lead or renewal converts on a program that picks this structure, and the reward pool they share.

name: Engagement calculation
description: Siren asks the app who earns an engagement, and its score, each time one triggers for a program whose engagement type picks this calculation.

name: Customer filter for programs
description: Siren asks the app whether an engagement may be written each time one triggers for a program that picks this filter.

name: Program group structure
description: Siren asks the app which program of a program group a sale or lead tries first, when the group picks this structure.

name: Collaborator group structure
description: Siren asks the app who sits above and below whom in a collaborator group each time a cascade runs over a group that picks this structure.
